competition.title: OOSC 4.0 Hackathon
competition.details:
GDG Prayagraj X IIITA Presents OOSC 4.0 Hackathon

Welcome to the OOSC 4.0 Hackathon, organized by the Google Developer Group (GDG) Prayagraj.

The OOSC 4.0 Hackathon is a premier innovation challenge designed for passionate developers, designers, and innovators. It provides a platform to transform ambitious ideas into impactful solutions while competing alongside talented teams from across the country.

Whether you're an experienced hacker or participating in your first hackathon, OOSC 4.0 offers an opportunity to learn, build, network, and showcase your creativity.

About OOSC:

The Opportunity Open Source Conference (OOSC) is an international conference dedicated to advancing the Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) ecosystem. It brings together developers, open-source maintainers, researchers, students, industry leaders, and technology enthusiasts from around the world to collaborate, exchange ideas, and drive innovation through open source. Each edition features technical talks, hands-on workshops, panel discussions, community sessions, and hackathons, creating an environment where learning meets real-world collaboration.

Hosted annually at leading academic institutions across India, previous editions of OOSC have been successfully organized at IIT Mandi and IIT Kanpur. The fourth edition will be hosted at IIIT Allahabad from 28th to 30th August 2026, continuing its mission of empowering contributors and strengthening the global open-source community.

Hackathon Format:

The competition will be conducted in two phases.

Phase 1 – Online Prototype Submission:

Teams will work on their solutions remotely and submit a working prototype before the submission deadline.

Timeline:

  • Registrations Open: 7th August 2026
  • Prototype Submission: 18th August – 23rd August 2026
  • problem statement will be released on: 18th August 
  • Registration Deadline: 21st August 2026
  • Shortlisted Teams Announced: 26th August 2026

The top 15 teams will advance to the finale.

Phase 2 – Hybrid Finale at IIIT Allahabad:

The shortlisted teams will be invited to the IIIT Allahabad campus to present their projects before an expert panel of judges from the technology industry, including representatives from Siftly and Spur.

Internship Opportunity: Top-performing participants may also get an opportunity to be considered for internship opportunities with the associated organizations, subject to the organizations' selection process

Every shortlisted team will receive a significant discount on OOSC Conference passes, allowing participants to attend one of Uttar Pradesh's largest flagship open-source technical events.

The conference will be held from 28th to 30th August 2026, featuring renowned speakers, technical sessions, networking opportunities, and community interactions.

The hackathon finale will take place in hybrid mode on 30th August 2026.

 

Experience OOSC 4.0 Conference

The OOSC 4.0 Hackathon is part of the larger Opportunity Open Source Conference (OOSC 4.0) — a three-day open-source technology conference hosted at IIIT Allahabad from 28th to 30th August 2026.

The conference brings together developers, students, researchers, open-source contributors, industry experts, and technology enthusiasts for expert talks, technical sessions, interactive workshops, panel discussions, networking, and community interactions.

Meet Industry Experts & Speakers

Hear from distinguished speakers from academia, startups, and enterprise engineering and explore topics across open source, AI, cloud computing, systems programming, IoT, and other emerging technologies.

Explore Speakers: https://oosc.iiita.ac.in/speakers

️ Conference Registration

Hackathon participation is completely free. However, attending the OOSC 4.0 Conference requires a separate conference pass.

Conference Pass: ₹699

Hackathon finalists will receive a special discount on conference passes.

View Conference Details on Unstop:
https://unstop.com/conferences/oosc-40-conference-opportunity-open-source-conference-oosc-40-indian-institute-of-information-technology-iii-1702204

Buy Your Conference Pass: https://oosc.iiita.ac.in/register

Exclusive Opportunity for Hackathon Finalists

The OOSC 4.0 Hackathon Finale will be evaluated by an expert panel, including judges from Siftly and Spur.

Top-performing participants may also get an opportunity to be considered for internship opportunities with the associated organizations.

This makes the finale more than just a competition — it is an opportunity to showcase your skills directly to industry professionals, receive expert feedback, build valuable connections, and potentially open doors to internship opportunities.

Team Size:

  • 2–3 members per team

Eligibility:

  • The hackathon is open to everyone.
  • Students from any college, university, or academic background are welcome to participate.

Registration Fee:

  • Hackathon Registration: Free
  • Attendance at the OOSC Conference requires a valid conference pass.

Problem Statements:

Problem statements will be released separately. They will span multiple domains and encourage participants to develop innovative, practical, and impactful solutions.

Phase 1 – Judging Criteria:

Projects will be evaluated based on:

  • Innovation and originality
  • Technical implementation
  • Problem-solving approach
  • Real-world impact
  • User experience and design
  • Scalability
  • Quality of presentation and demonstration

Prizes:

Compete with some of the brightest innovators and stand a chance to win exciting rewards.

  • 1st Prize: ₹25,000 Cash Prize
  • 2nd Prize: ₹10,000 Cash Prize
  • 3rd Prize: ₹5,000 Cash Prize

Additional Rewards:

  • Exciting goodies and exclusive OOSC merchandise for outstanding performers.
  • Certificates of Excellence for finalist teams.
  • Participation certificates for all eligible participants.
  • Special recognition awards for exceptional innovation, creativity, and technical excellence.

Join the OOSC 4.0 Hackathon, showcase your skills, and turn your ideas into impactful solutions while competing for exciting prizes and recognition.

Perks:

Participating in OOSC 4.0 is much more than competing for prizes. Shortlisted teams will have the opportunity to:

  • Attend the prestigious OOSC Conference at IIIT Allahabad.
  • Interact with renowned industry experts and speakers.
  • Network with talented developers and innovators from across the country.
  • Receive mentorship and valuable feedback from judges.
  • Showcase their projects before an experienced technical panel.
  • Build meaningful connections within the open-source and developer community.
  • Gain recognition through certificates and awards.
  • Experience the vibrant technical culture of IIIT Allahabad.
  • Complimentary refreshments will be provided during the offline finale and conference.
  • Opportunity to interact directly with industry judges from Siftly and Spur.
  • Potential internship opportunities for top-performing participants, subject to the respective organizations' selection process.

Rules:

  • Each team must consist of 2–3 members.
  • A participant may be part of only one team.
  • All submissions must be original work created during the hackathon.
  • Any form of plagiarism or unfair practice will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Teams must adhere to all deadlines announced by the organizers.
  • The decision of the judges and the organizing committee will be final and binding.
  • Additional rules and submission guidelines will be shared before the hackathon begins.

Recommendation:

Strong Google Technology Focus
An important aspect we are actively encouraging is the adoption of Google technologies and the modern Google developer ecosystem throughout the hackathon. Participants are being encouraged to explore tools such as Google Antigravity, Gemini, Gemini APIs, Google AI Studio, Firebase and other Google developer technologies while building their solutions.

organisation.name: Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT), Allahabad
organisation.description:
• Indian Institute of Information Technology Allahabad (IIITA) was established in 1999, as a center of excellence in IT and allied areas.
  • The institute was given the “Deemed University” status by Government of India in 2000.
  • The beautiful campus is spread over an area of 100 acres of land at Deoghat, Jhalwa.
  • The establishment of IIIT-A is a major step of Government of India towards strengthening the indigenous capability necessary for exploiting profitability and harnessing multi-dimensional facets of IT at all the levels and attaining expertise to enable the nation to emerge as a leading player in the global arena.
  • The campus is envisaged to be a fully residential one, with all its staff, faculty and students housed in different pockets.
  • All academic and residential areas are well connected to the institute network.

details.title: Phase 1 – Online Prototype Submission
details.display_text:
Teams will work remotely and build a functional prototype based on the hackathon problem statements.

Before the submission deadline, each team must submit:

  •  Prototype Link - live/hosted if possible, otherwise clear local-run instructions in README file
  •  GitHub repo with well-documented README
  •  Demo video (MANDATORY) — highlighting the core features (length should not exceed more than 10 minutes)

Evaluation will be based on innovation, technical implementation, feasibility, scalability, code quality, documentation, and presentation.

Late submissions will not be accepted.

details.title: Final Round
details.display_text: The shortlisted teams will be invited to the IIIT Allahabad campus to present their projects before an expert panel of judges. As a special benefit, every shortlisted team will receive a heavily discounted pass for the OOSC Conference, giving participants the opportunity to be part of one of Uttar Pradesh's largest open-source flagship technical events. The OOSC Conference will be held from 28 August to 30 August, featuring renowned speakers, technical sessions, networking opportunities, workshops, and community interactions. The Hackathon Finale will be conducted offline on 30 August at IIIT Allahabad. Shortlisted teams are expected to present their projects in person before the judging panel. This will also give participants the opportunity to fully experience the OOSC Conference, engage in networking sessions, attend workshops, and take part in various on-campus activities throughout the event.
